entries.title: Job 24:1
segments: Why are times not laid up by the Almighty? And why do not they that know him see his days?

entries.title: Job 24:2
segments: There are that remove the landmarks; They violently take away flocks, and feed them.

entries.title: Job 24:3
segments: They drive away the ass of the fatherless; They take the widow's ox for a pledge.

entries.title: Job 24:4
segments: They turn the needy out of the way: The poor of the earth all hide themselves.

entries.title: Job 24:5
segments: Behold, as wild asses in the desert They go forth to their work, seeking diligently for food; The wilderness [yieldeth] them bread for their children.

entries.title: Job 24:6
segments: They cut their provender in the field; And they glean the vintage of the wicked.

entries.title: Job 24:7
segments: They lie all night naked without clothing, And have no covering in the cold.

entries.title: Job 24:8
segments: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, And embrace the rock for want of a shelter.

entries.title: Job 24:9
segments: There are that pluck the fatherless from the breast, And take a pledge of the poor;

entries.title: Job 24:10
segments: [So that] they go about naked without clothing, And being hungry they carry the sheaves.

entries.title: Job 24:11
segments: They make oil within the walls of these men;  They tread [their] winepresses, and suffer thirst.

entries.title: Job 24:12
segments: From out of the populous city men groan,  And the soul of the wounded crieth out:  Yet God regardeth not the folly.

entries.title: Job 24:13
segments: These are of them that rebel against the light; They know not the ways thereof, Nor abide in the paths thereof.

entries.title: Job 24:14
segments: The murderer riseth with the light; He killeth the poor and needy; And in the night he is as a thief.

entries.title: Job 24:15
segments: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, Saying, No eye shall see me: And he disguiseth his face.

entries.title: Job 24:16
segments: In the dark they dig through houses: They shut themselves up in the day-time; They know not the light.

entries.title: Job 24:17
segments: For the morning is to all of them as thick darkness; For they know the terrors of the thick darkness.

entries.title: Job 24:18
segments: Swiftly they [pass away] upon the face of the waters; Their portion is cursed in the earth: They turn not into the way of the vineyards.

entries.title: Job 24:19
segments: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: [So doth] Sheol [those that] have sinned.

entries.title: Job 24:20
segments: The womb shall forget him; The worm shall feed sweetly on him; He shall be no more remembered; And unrighteousness shall be broken as a tree.

entries.title: Job 24:21
segments: He devoureth the barren that beareth not, And doeth not good to the widow.

entries.title: Job 24:22
segments: Yet [God] preserveth the mighty by his power: He riseth up that hath no assurance of life.

entries.title: Job 24:23
segments: [God] giveth them to be in security, and they rest thereon; And his eyes are upon their ways.

entries.title: Job 24:24
segments: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone; Yea, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, And are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.

entries.title: Job 24:25
segments: And if it be not so now, who will prove me a liar, And make my speech nothing worth?
